description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ServiceException' for handling exceptions within the application's service layer, including various constructors and methods to manage exception type and message codes.

classes.name: ServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending Java's Exception, used for signaling application service errors with additional attributes for exception type and message codes.

methods.name: setMessageCode
methods.description: Sets the message code associated with this exception.

methods.name: getMessageCode
methods.description: Retrieves the message code associated with this exception.

methods.name: getExceptionType
methods.description: Returns the integer representing the exception type.

methods.name: setExceptionType
methods.description: Sets the integer representing the exception type.

methods.name: ServiceException
methods.description: Constructors for creating ServiceException instances with various parameters such as message, cause, exception type, and message code.
